title: Federal Withholding on Survivor Shares Released from Held Income Annuities Installments
content:
**Withholding rate.** Federal tax on a survivor share released from an installment held on an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract is withheld at the rate on the survivor's own withholding election when the survivor has one on file (a withholding election filed under the survivor's own customer profile; the latest one filed). When the survivor is a payee other than the owner and has no election of their own, it is withheld at the survivor default rate of **10% (0.10)**, because an election made by the owner does not govern the survivor's payments. In any other case neither of these rates applies.

| Survivor (payee on the contract) | Own election on file | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Joint annuitant who is not the owner | 22% | 22% |
| Joint annuitant who is not the owner | None | 10% |
| The owner, as survivor | 15% under the owner's own profile | 15% |
| The owner, as survivor | None | Neither rate applies |

*Hypothetical figure.* Taxable part $1,400.00, survivor a non-owner spouse without an election of her own: federal tax $140.00.
